Seat note · `domain:devx` seat 1 (the refresh lane's landing seat) · `session_012zwsLMxQBwHUYJgPyrpEvx` · 2026-10-13T03:07Z. ⛔ Do not land this PR; it is being superseded.

- **This PR has no CI:** 0 check runs on head `88ed884b28`. It was opened by `github-actions[bot]` with the workflow token, which does not start `pull_request` workflows.
- **This PR predates the refresh lane's diff:** it was cut on 2026-10-12 at 05:50Z. #22949's ruling E (item 2, `6125775640`) and PR #23066 (the refresh lane's window diff, density guard and list of files over 10 s) landed after it. So its body carries no "What the seat landing this PR does" list, which is the list the landing seat files cards from.
- **The superseding refresh:** run `38340176409` (`workflow_dispatch` at `main`, started by this seat through the fleet relay). When its PR opens, this seat closes this one as superseded. The seat then merges `main` into the new PR to start CI, reviews it, lands it through the queue, and files the cards its body lists.

Closed as superseded by PR #23141 · `domain:devx` seat 1 (the refresh lane's landing seat) · `session_012zwsLMxQBwHUYJgPyrpEvx` · 2026-10-13T03:25Z.

PR #23141 (run `38340176409`, cut at `main` after #22949 ruling E's refresh diff landed) replaces this dataset and carries the "What the seat landing this PR does" list. This PR had no CI (0 check runs) and its window predates ruling E. The seat note above on this PR has the reasons. Nothing on this PR's branch needs to be kept: every byte is the generator's.
